name: G1 Secure Solutions Ltd
summary: G1 Secure Solutions Ltd provides security and safety services in Israel. It operates through Technologies, Security, Monitoring, and Hotelo divisions. The company offers human security and electronic security services, as well as low voltage systems; and planning, supply, installation, maintenance, and servicing services. It serves smart cities, monitoring and control programming, fire detection and extinguishing systems, and next generation safety tools; and neighborhoods and cities, private homes and businesses, retail facilities, and public institutions and buildings. The company was founded in 1937 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
